who.value: seller setting up Spotlight (services seller in the mock)

job.value: pick listings and a plan, then continue to pay with Coins

arrivedFrom.value: Spotlight entry from a listing or seller tools

questions.title: The screen's job is clear from the first screen
questions.why: 'Spotlight', 'Listing (3 selected)' and 'Plan' make it a promotion setup.

questions.title: The action that does the job stands out most
questions.why: 'Next' is the one filled button in the fixed bottom bar.

questions.title: Every label says what happens when tapped
questions.why: 'More listings' and 'Cost breakdown' are clear, but 'Next' doesn't say what comes next (review or pay).

questions.title: No terms this user wouldn't know
questions.why: 'Normal priority' / 'High priority', 'Max 21 clicks/day', '510–690 per click' and '10% CoinsBack' each need explaining.

questions.title: Only asks what this user can decide at this stage
questions.why: Choosing between 'Steady' and 'Get noticed' means weighing buyers reached, max clicks and max Coins per day — numbers a first-time seller can't easily judge.

questions.title: Advanced detail is tucked away
questions.why: Every plan card shows four stats up front and the 'Top results from electricians' competitor rows add more, none tucked away.

questions.title: Everything fits this stage and this user
questions.why: The 'Top results from electricians' benchmark and the CoinsBack strip add comparison and promo material on top of the setup task.

questions.title: Little reading needed to act
questions.why: Each plan card and competitor row is a stack of numbers the seller has to read before choosing.
